title: Word: Researcher agent entry points on the document canvas
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, licensing statements and documented controls are supported, and it distinguishes Researcher's existing behaviour from the still-undocumented Word entry points. The web search automation note should name the request-body property that sets the policy.

claims.claim: TCM supports this setting only in tenant-level Microsoft 365 Apps admin center policies.
claims.quote: The 20 Copilot resources are Office Cloud Policy Service (OCPS) settings. TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: applyOnce fails for the resource if the target setting is configured in any group-level policy.
claims.quote: ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.
